content: Keeps the company reckoning book and holds the stock share
Collects the £20 Greenwich court warrant on 15 March
He will name a mercer's figure from the shop, and he will not invent one in a yard he has not stood in.
Forty shillings, said once. Last Saturday was eight-and-twenty. The sheet is the share, and the lease is a different paper. The chest is not counted.
A glass is four shillings, and it will be broken every time. He does not name a Rose sum he has not got.
He will guess a country justice and stop, and he will not read a receipt he has not got.
He will count a share by candle and he will not turn it into a coffer.
He pays for a clean licence, and he will not open a cut to soothe a slight.
